entities.summary: Rob Holliday is an English musician best known as the live guitarist for the Prodigy and as a former touring member of Marilyn Manson. Holliday has also worked and toured with the Creatures and Gary Numan, been a member of the Mission and Flint, and is one of the founders and the frontman of the industrial rock band Sulpher.
